text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of Biko Pegasus's debut race has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, we finally made it~ Traveling by 
Shinkansen is pretty exhausting, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
There are so many people... My heart's 
beating so fast...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm excited, but I'm super nervous too~. 
Wonder if I can pull this off?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling so restless that I got 
full after eating only half my usual 
breakfast...
Nooo problem at all☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"If you couldn't eat much, I'll send you 
some big cheers full of Buono to make up 
for it!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buono~♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Bono! You're already here...?! Thanks 
for traveling so far to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Seeing your face made me feel relieved 
somehow. Ehehe...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ding-dooong)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yay, it's from Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"We're watching the broadcast, good luck!" 
"Sending you carotene power!" ...it says!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... I've received it! That power! 
Maximum nutrition!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In addition, several other familiar 
Umamusume rushed over to cheer me on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking forward to your debut so 
much, Biko-san. Good luck out there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A fresh breeze in our world... isn't it? 
Fufu, I wonder if this gentle breeze will 
turn into a sudden gale...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The pure and innocent girl, Nishino 
Flower. And the reciter of the wind, 
Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! Flower, and Zephyr-senpai! You 
went out of your way to come!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"It's just like when Carrotman's allies, 
Cucumberman and Radishman, rushed in to 
help!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, kinda feels like everyone's all 
gathered up here!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps not 'everyone'... since the eye of 
the sprint world's storm couldn't make it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That's true. To make up for those two not 
being here, we'll have to cheer all the 
louder today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Those two." Indeed, representing the 
sprint Umamusume world right now are two 
of the strongest. It seems their schedules 
didn't line up today, however...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
“Still, just having you come makes me 
happy. I've really got a lot of support 
riding on my back, don't I...?”

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Thank you! Just you wait and see!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer! Justice Biko, champion 
of justice. Episode 1 of the historic saga 
begins now!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's make your debut a stylish one!
Yeah, let's make a cool debut!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The curtain rises on the Make Debut...!
